desc:
Someone threw away their Bitcoin… can you find it? 🤑

🗑️ Clear piles of trash to find hidden USB drives!
💻 Plug them in to earn in-game Bitcoin!
🦠 Take your cash—or keep going and risk losing your haul to a virus!
🏗️ Buy better tools, cool gadgets, and HUGE cranes!
🏡 Go from broke to buying your dream mansion!

One pile of trash. One lucky find. How rich can you get? 😈

Join the group and like the game for updates and codes!

Tags: Find The Needle, Trash, Bitcoin, Story, Adventure, USB, Money , Search, Needle in a Haystack, Clean all the Leaves
